objective: Implement and verify provider-neutral Codex CLI and Claude Code development harnesses with repository-based handoff continuity.
acceptanceCriteria: Both CLI adapters implement one provider-neutral contract.
Safe bounded probes report installation and usability where determinable.
A concise packet is generated from task, state, checkpoint, verification, and Git context.
Selected harness launches capture structured exit, output, timeout, and diagnostic data.
Run state and checkpoints allow another harness to continue without chat history.
Automated Codex-to-Claude continuity simulation and all project verification pass.
A live Codex-to-Claude handoff is demonstrated with the owner's authenticated CLIs.
notes: Provider-neutral adapters, packet generation, structured run persistence, checkpoint continuity, and automated portability simulation are implemented.
Corrected Codex global approval argument placement; the installed CLI accepts the command.
Authentication probes preserve unknown status for inaccessible/unsupported authentication and timeouts; explicit logout is false. Launch validates required project context before invoking a harness.
Separate fake Codex and Claude processes prove the receiver reads Codex work, checkpoint, task acceptance criteria, state, and Git-derived packet without chat history.
The outer live Codex run succeeded through ChatGPT subscription authentication and produced runs/20260910082604189-codex-M01-001.json without receiving prior conversation history.
The live Codex worker reviewed the implementation, added context preflight and safer authentication-state detection, and expanded the verified suite to 13 tests.
Claude Code 2.1.266 is installed from Anthropic's official Windows package; owner subscription authentication is pending.
nextAction: Complete Claude subscription authentication, then launch Claude on M01-001 using only the generated repository packet and verify its understanding of the Codex handoff.
